slice: Cross-surface orchestration + shared status/action spine polish
intent: Repair the perception that the dashboard is a separate mix of panels by adding one Bominal-inspired operating spine that connects FD-001 product delivery, Workflow, Messenger, Mail, Community, Oyatie Cloud, and Evidence as a single cohesive product surface.
product_direction: Oyatie builds a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfoods all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added ProductActivitySpine/ProductActivityStep to the render envelope so SSR and API payloads share the same cross-surface operating model.

Inserted a top-fold Product Activity Spine with Bominal-style route rail, workflow-like grid lane, inspector card, and status bar connecting FD-001, Workflow, Messenger, Mail, Community, Oyatie Cloud, and Evidence.

Bound the spine to shared local dispatch in prototype-interactions.js; route buttons, surface command bar, Work Hub surfaces, cloud cockpit, evidence console, and service catalog all update common route/status/inspector state.
Added responsive flat/corp-web styling that preserves no-horizontal-overflow at 1440, 1024, and 390 widths while keeping visual-only boundaries explicit.

before_metrics.issue: Top-level dashboard had many polished panels but no single visible action/status spine proving they are one product; workflow/comms/cloud/evidence routes felt slice-local.

interaction_assertions: Initial SSR page renders #product-activity-spine with active FD-001 graph and REC-FD001-CLOUD-009 proof.
Clicking Mail in the spine routes to #work-hub, selects Mail, updates the global status, and changes inspector title to 'Mail · formal approval brief'.
Clicking Oyatie Cloud routes to #cloud-ops-cockpit, selects the cloud route, updates the status, and scrolls the cloud cockpit into view.
No browser console/page errors were observed in desktop, tablet, or mobile audits.
responsive_assertions: 1440x1000: spine visible at top fold, no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 1440).
1024x900: spine stacks responsively, no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 1024).
390x844: spine remains visible and vertically stacked, no horizontal page overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 390).

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-inspired professional operator dashboard with coherent action spine, flat surfaces, left route rail, central workflow lane, right inspector, and explicit local boundary.
differences_remaining: Full page is still a very large product demo; this slice adds a unifying top-fold spine but does not yet re-architect every lower section into a single viewport IDE.
Backend wiring remains intentionally absent per prototype requirement.
visual_verdict.reasoning: The visible route rail + flow lane + inspector/status bar closes the main cohesion gap without copying the Bominal reference. It strengthens Workflow/Messenger/Mail/Community/Cloud/Evidence as one product and stays visually interactive/responsive.

commands.cmd: podman restart oya-frontend-prototype-live and curl http://127.0.0.1:3000/

known_limits: Visual interactivity remains local-only and deliberately unwired: no workflow execution, external mail/community send, IAM, billing, deploy, or cloud mutation.
Overall dashboard completion remains unproven; this is one verified polish slice toward the complete cohesive mockup.
